scripts.check: vp check && bun test && bun run sdk:test
scripts.e2e:checks: bun run data:prepare && bun run tests/e2e/src/index.ts
scripts.sdk:doctor: uv run --project services/panda-adapter python -m panda_adapter doctor
scripts.sdk:init: uv run --project services/panda-adapter python -m panda_adapter initialize
scripts.sdk:test: uv run --project services/panda-adapter python -m unittest discover -s services/panda-adapter/tests
scripts.data:prepare: bun run data:install && bun run data:validate
scripts.data:rebuild: bun run data:base && bun run data:audit-support && bun run data:package && bun run data:prepare
